decisions.evidence: Across all six neighbors, the same pattern repeats: the query consistently carries multiple chloroalkene motifs, and several other comparisons add mutagenic-leaning structural features. Some exposure-related descriptors, including higher logP/logD, higher sp3 fraction, and in a few cases lower heteroatom burden or lower TPSA, point in the opposite direction, but those effects are secondary here. The repeated presence of the chloroalkene toxicophore and the additional halogenated/reactive features outweigh the countervailing descriptors, so the overall prediction is option (B): is mutagenic.
